[attribute-colspan]
=== `@colspan` Column Span (NISO JATS table model)

Table attribute used to request horizontal spanning of more than one column. (This attribute is based on and intended to be converted easily to the XHMTL `colspan` attribute.)

#### Usage/Remarks
To specify horizontal spanning, this attribute contains the number of columns that a table cell will span. (The table cell will be tagged with a <<element-td,`<td>`>> or <<element-th,`<th>`>> element.)

#### OPTIONAL (defaults to 1) on elements:  <<element-td,`<td>`>>, 
                  <<element-th,`<th>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Counting number| How many column widths this cell will span, for example,
                        “`3`”.
| Default value| 1 (Spans 1 column)
|===
